name: Pangangalap: gathering on the shore
description: Shellfish, sea urchins and seaweed gathered at low tide, mostly by women and children, were a steady part of the coastal diet.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Francisco Ignacio Alcina, Historia de las islas e indios de Bisayas (1668), trans. Cantius Kobak and Lucio Gutiérrez (UST Publishing House, 2002–2005)

lore.en: At low tide, people walked the flats and reefs gathering shellfish, crabs, sea urchins and seaweed into baskets. It was everyday work that fed a family between bigger catches.
lore.fil: Sa pagkati, naglalakad ang mga tao sa bahura at mababaw na dagat at nangangalap ng kabibe, alimango, sea urchin at damong-dagat sa mga basket. Pang-araw-araw na gawain ito na nagpapakain sa pamilya sa pagitan ng malalaking huli.

inGame.en: Shore gathering gives a little fresh fish and shellfish without boats.
inGame.fil: Nagbibigay ang pangangalap ng kaunting sariwang lamang-dagat nang walang bangka.
